title: This is a must experience in Granada
text: We did our 3 hours Tapas tour in Granada with Grego. He was super flexible with me, my sister and another couple from the UK. It was an evening of great food and great company. Grego clearly wanted to ensure we were all cared for and have a great time. Grego is wonderful and we highly recommend him - thank you Grego!
author: Cynthia_H

title: Customisable to your liking
text: What great tapas tour in Granada! We enjoyed some delicious dishes and drinks, with the flexibility to choose what we wanted to eat and drink along the way. Our guide, Grego, was the perfect host – friendly and knowledgeable. A wonderful way to experience Granada’s food scene while meeting fellow travellers. Highly recommend! 🍷🍤🇪🇸
author: Robyn_D

title: Sabor Granaino
text: Wear Good walking shoes to enjoy the local flavor. Be open to the suggestions made by your guide and be ready to enjoy new flavors.

title: Great night, Great guide, Great experience
text: What a lovely night with some great people in the most authentic tapas bars in Granada. We were treated to some amazing food in some of the best places that we would have never have found ourselves. Thank you for a lspecial night.
author: Johnfbradford

title: Great tour
text: We have been on several food tours and this one is unique.  Normally your food is all picked for you, but this tour you get lots of input.  We had so much food and learned lots about Granada.  Also don’t be afraid to ask for something sweet.  It was well worth it!!
author: Jackie_C

title: Very Enjoyable Tapas Tour - Recommended
text: Enjoyed visiting 3 different tapas bars with Grego. All very authentic with very different tapas which allowed us to try a few dishes outside of our normal comfort zones. A very enjoyable and fun evening.
author: Andrew_G

title: Tasty
text:
Our guide Gerg met us in one of Granada's many plazas.  We had already found the rest of our party.  We were a small group , just 2 couples as Gerg explained that he felt his guests got more out of the experience that way.  I would suggest doing this trip at the start of your break to better understand how true tapas bars work, and also to encourage you to try food and drinks that might be out of your normal comfort zone.

title: Great experience in Granada
text: The tour was great! The tapas guide is local to Granada and is very knowledgeable on where the best tapas spots are. While walking between places he gave us a brief history of the places we were passing as well as giving us some good insight into the other things we should do while we were here. Overall great experience and great food! If you are looking to try some Spanish tapas I would definitely recommend.
author: Jessica_A

title: A relaxed and interesting tapas tour
text:
A truly pleasant half day with Gergo Lazar, who runs this service as a sole trader. He specially gave me a one-on-one tour of three authentically local tapas bars and walked with me to the oldest such bar in Granada as well as the oldest shop, once frequented by Lorca. 

Our three hours included drinks and six tapas offerings from a large selection of choices and our conversation ranged widely from the artichokes to zucchinis, from AI to Zoom culture. Terrific experience.
author: ElaineS1608
